title: Team: Approve adds the requester at once in a picked role (no invitation); a waiting request stays under Unread after Review; a member who left reads Left; a team link stays on Team
steps: Common setup (tests/regression/README.md § Common setup): ORIGIN (= O), A (an Owner) and COOKIE_A, api. KEY = a site where A is Owner. R = req-<unix seconds>@example.test, L = left-<unix seconds>@example.test; mint their cookies like A's (never print them).

R: POST /me/sites/<KEY>/join-request, then wait 70 s so the request is older than 'just now'. L: A invites L as editor on KEY (POST /api/team/invite), L POST /api/sites/<KEY>/accept, then L POST /api/sites/<KEY>/leave.

Browser (new Playwright context, cookie COOKIE_A): open O + '/<KEY>/?tab=tracy:inbox'; in the card of .tracy-inbox-row.is-card naming R press Review; wait 6 s; open the same address again and record STILL = count of those cards. Record DB = read_at is not null, settled_at is not null of A's newest team.join_request row on KEY (pq).

Open O + '/<KEY>?open=my-sites&team=<KEY>'; record LEFT = text of the roster row naming L; in R's row press Approve; record DIALOG = the dialog's text; press the dialog's Approve; wait 5 s; record ROW = text of R's row. Record SEAT = role, accepted_at is not null of R's seat on KEY, and T1 = count of R's team.invited rows (pq).

Team link guard: open O + '/<KEY>/?tab=tracy:inbox', then O + '/<KEY>?open=browser&page=/&mode=interactive'; then in a NEW page open O + '/<KEY>?open=my-sites&team=<KEY>'; record the active tab's text every 2 s for 20 s (ACTIVE) and the final query (QUERY).
Clean up: api a GET /api/team, and DELETE /api/sites/<KEY>/seats/<id> for R's live seat.
expect: The unit seams exit 0 with '# fail 0'.
STILL === 1 and DB === 't|f' (read by Review, not settled, still listed under Unread).
DIALOG contains 'Approve request' and does not contain 'Seats are granted when they accept' or 'Send the invitation'.
ROW contains 'Active' and 'Granted just now' (the approval time, not the request's); SEAT === 'editor|t'; T1 === '0'.
Every ACTIVE sample starts with 'Team'; QUERY contains 'tab=tracy:team' and not 'open=my-sites'.
evidence: On cowork.tracy.site 04/10: Approve opened the invite wizard ('Seats are granted when they accept'); Review hid a still-unanswered request from Unread; a member who left showed 'Revoked'; a View team / Review link landed on the Browser tab one click in two. After #878: the approved row read 'Granted 53 minutes ago', the time of the request.
fence: TeamView's Approve calls approveRequestInit through the invite door (admitToSite approves the request: accepted seat, T3/T2b, no T1); notifications/store.js WAITING keeps unsettled invites and requests in Unread and the count; the leave door writes removal_kind 'left' and closedAs reads it; openFromLink waits for a session, strips the query only after the tab opened, and guards it for LINK_GUARD_MS.
